description: Text, block and item displays: summoned with their whole data (transformation as matrix and decomposed, interpolation, billboard, brightness, glow, shadow, text options, item display context), changed with data merge and teleported with a teleport duration; their saved data (without UUID) is stored into a probe chest every tick.

actions.command: setblock 0 -60 0 minecraft:chest
item replace block 0 -60 0 container.0 with minecraft:paper

summon minecraft:text_display 1.5 -60 1.5 {text:{"text":"Hi","color":"red"},background:123456,line_width:50,see_through:1b,alignment:"left",billboard:"center",shadow:1b,default_background:0b,text_opacity:200b,brightness:{sky:15,block:3},view_range:2.0f,shadow_radius:0.5f,shadow_strength:0.7f,width:2f,height:1f,glow_color_override:16711680,Tags:["t"]}

summon minecraft:block_display 2 -60 2 {block_state:{id:"minecraft:oak_log",properties:{axis:"x"}},interpolation_duration:5,start_interpolation:0,transformation:{left_rotation:[0f,0f,0f,1f],right_rotation:{axis:[0f,1f,0f],angle:0.5f},translation:[0.5f,0f,0f],scale:[2f,1f,1f]},Glowing:1b,Tags:["b"]}

summon minecraft:item_display 2.5 -59 0.5 {item:{id:"minecraft:diamond_sword",count:1,components:{"minecraft:damage":4}},item_display:"head",transformation:[1f,0f,0f,0f,0f,1f,0f,0.5f,0f,0f,1f,0f,0f,0f,0f,1f],teleport_duration:3,billboard:"vertical",Tags:["i"]}
summon minecraft:text_display 0.5 -59 2.5 {text:"plain",alignment:"right",Tags:["u"]}
data modify storage t:p dt set from entity @e[tag=t,limit=1]
data remove storage t:p dt.UUID
data modify storage t:p db set from entity @e[tag=b,limit=1]
data remove storage t:p db.UUID
data modify storage t:p di set from entity @e[tag=i,limit=1]
data remove storage t:p di.UUID
data modify storage t:p du set from entity @e[tag=u,limit=1]
data remove storage t:p du.UUID
data modify block 0 -60 0 Items[0].components."minecraft:custom_data" set from storage t:p

execute store result storage t:p m1 int 1 run data merge entity @e[tag=b,limit=1] {transformation:{left_rotation:[0f,0f,0f,1f],right_rotation:[0f,0f,0f,1f],translation:[0f,1f,0f],scale:[1f,1f,1f]},start_interpolation:0,interpolation_duration:4}
execute store result storage t:p m2 int 1 run tp @e[tag=i,limit=1] 3.5 -59 3.5 90 0
execute store result storage t:p m3 int 1 run data merge entity @e[tag=t,limit=1] {text:"changed",line_width:10,billboard:"fixed",background:0}
execute store result storage t:p m4 int 1 run data modify entity @e[tag=u,limit=1] text set value {"text":"x","bold":true}

execute store result storage t:p m6 int 1 run data merge entity @e[tag=i,limit=1] {item:{id:"minecraft:stone",count:2},item_display:"gui"}
